items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I didn't sit down and moan, me about Lot's wife. He said, "Son, and you go out in the world, don't look back."

ctx.x: You see, so after that, I didn't -- just went on out and -- but I have always been one thing, Chris. I don't believe in looking back. I didn't sit down and moan, me about Lot's wife. He said, "Son, and you go out in the world, don't look back. If you make a mistake, try not to do that again. But don't worry about it. Don't sit there and grieve over that mistake." So it's just one of those things. You say, well, better luck next time. And we went on out and did some more touring. But I never got together that kind…
